findings.description: Work package wp-coordinator scope omits agent-coordinator/src/profile_loader.py and its tests, but tasks 3.7 and 3.8 and design D5 explicitly assign renaming internal Bao credential inputs in profile_loader.py to wp-coordinator. In an isolated worktree, edits to profile_loader.py will fail scope boundary checks.
findings.resolution: Add agent-coordinator/src/profile_loader.py and agent-coordinator/tests/test_profile_loader.py to wp-coordinator write_allow scope in work-packages.yaml, and update the wp-coordinator description to cover tasks 3.1-3.8.

findings.description: Work package wp-dispatch scope permits writing only api_key_resolver.py and its tests, but task 4.2 explicitly requires updating review_dispatcher.py call sites (lines 3027 and 3068). Because review_dispatcher.py is omitted from write_allow, updating the dispatch call sites to pass canonical principal and vendor cannot be completed within package scope.
findings.resolution: Add skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py and its test file to wp-dispatch write_allow scope in work-packages.yaml.

findings.description: Schema openbao-event.schema.json defines additionalProperties: false and lacks an action property, but specs/configuration/spec.md (line 70) mandates: "Every mutation, including retired role, policy, and path removal, SHALL emit an audit record with principal, resource, action, and outcome". Emitting an action property will fail schema validation. Additionally, the resource property regex ^(role|policy|agent_path|vendor_path|identity_snapshot)$ rejects "bootstrap", causing openbao.bootstrap.issued events with resource: bootstrap to fail validation.
findings.resolution: Add an action property (e.g. enum: [create, update, delete, retire, issue, reject, refresh, expire, lookup]) and add bootstrap to the resource regex in openbao-event.schema.json.

findings.description: Scenario COORD-07 requires the audit event to identify "authorization" as the failure class, but openbao-event.schema.json names the field error_code and restricts it to uppercase enum values like AUTHORIZATION_DENIED; setting failure_class: authorization violates additionalProperties: false, while error_code: authorization violates the enum. Furthermore, scenario COORD-05 and design D4 specify emitting a recovery event on valid refresh, but openbao-event.schema.json lacks a recovery event in its event enum (only openbao.identity.refresh_succeeded exists).
findings.resolution: Align scenario COORD-07 to expect error_code: AUTHORIZATION_DENIED, and either add openbao.identity.recovered to openbao-event.schema.json or specify that COORD-05 emits openbao.identity.refresh_succeeded.

findings.description: In principal-topology.schema.json, agent_kv_path requires pattern ^secret/agents/[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$, and contracts/README.md line 8 calls secret/agents/<name> the "KV logical path". However, in specs/configuration/spec.md (Scenario CFG-03 and line 21), the logical KV-v2 path is defined as agents/<name> relative to mount secret. Passing secret/agents/<name> to HVAC kv.v2 methods with mount_point="secret" causes HVAC to request /v1/secret/data/secret/agents/<name>, duplicating the mount prefix and violating the OpenBao KV-v2 policy paths.
findings.resolution: Update agent_kv_path pattern in principal-topology.schema.json to ^agents/[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ (or clarify in README.md and adapter specification that agent_kv_path includes the mount prefix and the adapter must strip the mount before calling HVAC).

findings.description: work-packages.yaml contracts.files list omits newly added contract schemas session-cache.schema.json and migration-map.schema.json, and wp-contracts locks.keys does not lock them. These contracts are now required dependencies of tasks 1.3, 2.1, 4.1, and 5.2, but are not tracked as formal contract artifacts in the work package manifest.
findings.resolution: Add session-cache.schema.json and migration-map.schema.json to contracts.files and add their lock keys to wp-contracts in work-packages.yaml.

findings.description: The plan specifies that agent credentials reside at secret/data/agents/<name> and vendor credentials at secret/data/vendors/<vendor>, but neither contracts, design, nor specs define the expected JSON document schema/keys inside these KV-v2 documents (e.g. {"api_key": "..."} vs {"key": "..."} vs placeholder name). Producer (bao_seed.py) and consumers (identity-reader snapshot loader, api_key_resolver.py) risk drifting on document key names.
findings.resolution: Formally specify the KV-v2 payload contract for agent and vendor secret documents (e.g., standardizing on {"api_key": "<secret>"} or a versioned document schema) and validate in adapter tests.

findings.description: Requirement "Registry Projection Invariant" (specs/agent-identity/spec.md line 60 and scenario AI-09) mandates CI verification of the credential projection alongside existing profile and identity projections in test_registry_projection.py. However, work-packages.yaml does not include agent-coordinator/tests/test_registry_projection.py in wp-projection write_allow scope (only test_agents_config.py is included).
findings.resolution: Add agent-coordinator/tests/test_registry_projection.py to wp-projection write_allow scope in work-packages.yaml.

findings.description: Task 5.1 and Scenario CFG-15 require pinning the live OpenBao container fixture and failing on mutable tags like latest. The repo defines the OpenBao fixture image at agent-coordinator/docker-compose.yml (currently quay.io/openbao/openbao:latest), but docker-compose.yml is not included in wp-integration write_allow scope.
findings.resolution: Add agent-coordinator/docker-compose.yml to wp-integration write_allow scope in work-packages.yaml.
